premise: The unconventional methodological choice that revolutionized primate research in Tanzania.
hook: Instead of assigning numbers to the chimpanzees she studied, she gave them names—a practice scorned by traditional zoologists.
key_facts: Arrived at Gombe Stream National Park in 1960 with no prior university degree in science.
Observed chimpanzees making and using tools, contradicting the scientific definition of humans as the sole toolmakers.
Secured funding from the Leakey Foundation and later completed a PhD at Cambridge University.
Founded the Jane Goodall Institute to promote global wildlife conservation.

premise: The humble beginnings of a Delta blues legend who played on street corners before recording hits.
hook: He worked as a tractor driver in Mississippi cotton fields while earning coins by singing gospel and blues on street corners.
key_facts: Worked on a cotton plantation in Indianola, Mississippi, during his youth.
Traveled to Memphis, Tennessee, seeking a radio break, eventually working as a disc jockey known as the Beale Street Blues Boy.
Named his signature Gibson electric guitars 'Lucille' after an incident involving a tavern fire.
Recorded dozens of influential blues standards over a decades-long touring career.

premise: A young football player cut from the Canadian Football League finds himself with seven dollars and no backup plan.
hook: He had seven dollars in his pocket after his sports dream ended. Then he stepped into a wrestling ring.
key_facts: Played college football for the University of Miami national championship team
Cut from the Calgary Stampeders in the CFL early in his professional career
Transitioned to professional wrestling under the name Rocky Maivia before achieving global fame
Became one of the highest-paid actors in Hollywood

premise: A college dropout builds a computer in his parents' garage with his friend during the 1970s tech boom.
hook: Before building iPhones, he dropped out of college, slept on friends' floors, and built circuit boards in a garage.
key_facts: Dropped out of Reed College after attending for one semester
Co-founded Apple Computer in 1976 inside a suburban garage
Traveled to India seeking spiritual guidance prior to starting Apple

premise: Refusing to sell his screenplay unless he played the lead role, despite being nearly broke and homeless.
hook: He was offered a life-changing sum for his script, but he had one non-negotiable demand.
key_facts: Wrote the screenplay for Rocky in three days after watching a boxing match.
Turned down high offers from studio executives who wanted an established star.
Lived in extreme poverty and reportedly sold his dog temporarily to buy food.
Rocky went on to win the Academy Award for Best Picture in 1977.

premise: Facing eviction and having only seven dollars to his name before finding his footing in professional wrestling.
hook: Before he was a global movie star, his family was evicted with only seven dollars in their pockets.
key_facts: Played college football for the University of Miami and briefly in the Canadian Football League.
Suffered a career-ending shoulder injury that led to being cut from his football team.
Entered professional wrestling with the WWF as Rocky Maivia.
Transformed into 'The Rock' and became one of the most popular wrestlers in history.

premise: Trading a higher upfront directing salary for merchandising and sequel rights to an unproven sci-fi film.
hook: He gave up a $500,000 directing fee for merchandising rights, creating one of the richest deals in history.
key_facts: Wrote and directed Star Wars, released in theaters in 1977.
Negotiated with 20th Century Fox to retain consumer products and sequel rights.
Studied film at the University of Southern California.
The film became a massive global cultural phenomenon.

premise: Working as a wafer shopkeeper and photographer before finding widespread theatrical and film success in his 40s.
hook: He spent years running a local bakery counter and shooting sports before his breakout movie role at age 41.
key_facts: Managed his family's bakery business and worked as a waiter at the Taj Mahal Palace.
Worked professionally as a sports photographer before entering theater.
Made his major Bollywood film debut in the 2003 comedy Munna Bhai M.B.B.S.
Became one of Indian cinema's most versatile and recognized character actors.
